description: Had signed, and was already turned away.
name: Edmund Tilney

description: Drilled the empty chair, and put the bow on the tables.
name: George Bryan

description: Marked the Nurse, the forty, the cloaks, and the silence about the king.
name: John Heminges

description: Spoke low, under the note, and was not asked to go higher.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Not in the yard. His afternoon was on the board, and that was all.
name: Philip Henslowe

description: Refused a longer death, and refused a cloak that was not his.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Bowed four times, then accepted once.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Kept the Nurse's words, and lost the long lament.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Played the old man and did not explain the sea.
name: William Shakespeare
